findings.title: Preserved lawful fuel notes block all later dossier saves while relocked
findings.contract: docs/CUSTOMER_FIRST_V1.md requires correction/unknown demotion to relock fuel without losing history, while the operator can continue project and customer work.
findings.evidence: Independent private temporary SQLite probe: v1 saved sourced reviewed bridge need, sourced buyer, understood test conversation and lawful COORDINATING note (fuel_unlocked=true). v2 appended UNKNOWN buyer evidence, reset status to NOT_STARTED and saved successfully with the original note retained (fuel_unlocked=false). v3 changed only the customer brief, kept the original note unchanged, and Store.save raised 'new or changed fuel notes are locked until the gate is unlocked'. The condition tests 'or not previous_gate[fuel_unlocked]' on every locked save, so normal later edits remain blocked.
findings.repair_target: While locked, reject a newly introduced or changed fuel note, but permit an unchanged previously lawful note on every subsequent save. Keep fuel status locked and retain the note; test two or more later unrelated saves after demotion.

prior_findings.RV1: Repaired in this candidate: validate_doc requires a traceable HTTP(S) source URL for REVIEWED scope and buyer claims; gate checks source validity. The browser labels the requirement.
prior_findings.RV2: Partially repaired: new notes while initially locked are rejected and lawful notes survive the first relock; RV4 identifies the later-save regression.
prior_findings.RV3: Repaired in this candidate: browser displays the saved server gate; retained synthetic browser regression shows UNKNOWN buyer and disabled fuel controls at v7, then exact sourced correction and unlock at v8.
